title: KVComp: A High-Performance, LLM-Aware, Lossy Compression Framework for KV Cache
summary: Replaces full-precision KV caches or simpler compression methods with lossy compression designed together with the attention kernel. Integration requires custom kernels and a new inference component, with a residual risk of quality loss. It may not suit unmodified vLLM or TGI, short contexts where the KV cache is not the bottleneck, or tasks sensitive to small attention errors.
rationale: Worth testing for long contexts on a 24 GB GPU, provided the kernels are available and accuracy is checked on the actual workload.

claims.statement: Replaces full-precision KV caches or simpler compression methods with lossy compression designed together with the attention kernel. Integration requires custom kernels and a new inference component, with a residual risk of quality loss. It may not suit unmodified vLLM or TGI, short contexts where the KV cache is not the bottleneck, or tasks sensitive to small attention errors.
Reports a 47% average and up to 83% greater memory-reduction rate than existing methods, with little or no accuracy degradation; sometimes outperforms cuBLAS-based attention kernels.
